llm.summary: This classroom-coaching skill is purpose-aligned and discloses its use of class planning and student grouping data.

dimensions.detail: The shared conventions explicitly scope the library to Mainland China Chinese K12 use, with curriculum, language, crisis contacts, and privacy assumptions requiring localization before use elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown and JSON documentation/templates only; I found no executable install script, dependency installer, remote code retrieval, shell execution instruction, or static-scan result.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation examples are broad classroom phrases, but the artifact also lists adjacent requests to route elsewhere and repeatedly limits the skill to implementation coaching rather than lesson planning, test design, or student analytics.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill depends on platform memory and timing capabilities, but persistence is disclosed, teacher-facing writes are待确认条目/confirmed entries, privacy controls are listed, and logs are designed to avoid real names and individual student labeling.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides classroom interaction, questioning, grouping, timing, and post-class observation guidance for teachers. Reading lesson goals, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries fits that purpose, and it states it writes only aggregate interactionLogs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese K12 teacher classroom-interaction workflows when you are comfortable letting it read class profiles, lesson-plan context, student tiers, and weakness summaries, and write teacher-confirmed aggregate classroom interaction records. Do not deploy it directly for other regions or languages without localizing curriculum assumptions, crisis contacts, and privacy rules.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases are classroom-interaction phrases matching the stated purpose; the skill includes an adjacent-request routing table and does not show hidden or automatic data access beyond invocation.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only materials are consistent with the artifact’s explicit Mainland China Chinese K12 scope; this is a deployment/localization note rather than evidence of deceptive behavior.
[SDI-1] expected: Access to lessonPlans is disclosed as read-only context for objectives and question-chain drafts, while the skill explicitly says it does not write lessonPlans.
[SDI-2] expected: Access to studentTiers and weaknessRank is sensitive but disclosed and used to tailor participation paths and questioning focus; the artifact says these fields are read, not written, by this skill.
